title: 茶水间英文 - 11月5日 | 蓝色浪潮席卷、腾讯Hy4、费内巴切爆冷
description:
Democrats swept the 2026 midterms, taking both the House and the Senate, with Texas flipping blue for the first time in thirty years. Tencent launched Hy4, a giant open-source AI model that can see images and operate a computer by itself, and Fenerbahce stunned Liverpool three two in a wild Champions League night in Istanbul. Alex and Jordan turn all three into lines you can steal for small talk.

美国中期选举民主党大获全胜，同时拿下众议院和参议院，得州三十年来首次翻蓝；腾讯发布开源大模型 Hy4，能看图、能自己操作电脑；欧冠之夜费内巴切三比二爆冷击败利物浦。本期 Alex 和 Jordan 把这三条新闻都聊成了能直接拿去跟朋友说的口语。

Words to steal 生词本：
- blue wave — 蓝色浪潮；民主党大胜
- sweep — 横扫；大获全胜
- flip a seat — 翻转席位；夺下对方的席位
- divided government — 分裂政府；两党分治
- open-source — 开源的
- hands-on — 亲自动手的；能直接操作的
- come from behind — 后来居上；逆转取胜
- underdog — 弱势一方；黑马
